observations: What I read: I read the request JSON, source/original.txt, page-04.svg (as SVG text, not rendered) and AGENTS.md, docs/REVISION-AND-REVIEWS.md and docs/PROMPTS.md. I opened and looked at these PNGs with Read: assets/panels/04-1.png, main-cast.png, nurse.png, checkin-patients.png and vision-cast.png. I also looked at these adjacent panels for context: 03-1, 03-5, 04-2, 04-3, 05-1, 05-2, 05-3, 05-4, 06-2 and 07-1. Every file opened. The runtime gave me no task ID, so reviewer.task is null.

Ravi matches main-cast.png. He has short side-parted black hair, a trimmed beard, thick straight brows close to the eyes, warm eyes that crease as he smiles, a square jaw, a light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers and a watch on his left wrist. He is standing, smiling and looking up to the upper right, which reads as 'ready, pleased'.

Hands: his left hand, with the watch, grips the dark-brown bag strap at chest height, and the strap runs over his left shoulder. His right hand is pushed into his right trouser pocket. The phone is hidden inside the hand and pocket, so the art shows the end of 'tucking ravi-phone into his pocket' rather than the phone itself. That is acceptable, and it follows on from 03-5, where the phone is in his right hand.

Shoulder bag: in 03-5 the bag is on his lap. Here it hangs from his left shoulder at his left hip. That matches before 'on his lap', during 'back on his left shoulder' and heldBy ravi.left. The same bag hangs from his left shoulder again in 07-1.
Waiting TV: it is wall-mounted in the upper right, with a light-teal screen and one empty white strip. There are no numbers or letters, so the 'NOW · A-12' label has a clean place.

The front row of three navy waiting chairs to screen-left of Ravi is empty, so Raman's and Priya's seats from 03-5 are vacant. Two other patients sit further back, seen from behind in grey and brown, as the scene asks. Meera is behind the reception monitor at the right. She has her side braid over her left shoulder, a blue patterned kurta and hands at the keyboard. She is smiling rather than looking at the screen, which is fine for a background figure.
There is no readable text anywhere. The QR stand shows only an abstract block pattern. A vitals cart with a cuff and an oximeter behind Ravi sets up the vitals corner in 04-2.

Minor, not blocking: the 'plain wall at the upper left' is a flat pure-white rectangle with a hard lower edge, not painted wall. On its left it cuts across the window frame, so a sliver of window shows at the far left. According to page-04.svg, the caption box covers most of the window cut. A thin cut strip just below the caption and the hard white-to-wall edge further right will probably stay visible. The lettering review must check this on the composited page. Page 03-1 uses the same caption-band treatment.

Minor, not blocking, already in other pages: the waiting chairs here and in 03-1 and 03-5 are navy, and the reception desk front is pale wood. In 04-2 and 07-1 the chairs are teal and the counter has a teal front. Since 07-1 already differs, I do not count this against 04-1.

What I read: I read the request JSON, source/original.txt and page-04.svg (as text). I opened and looked at these PNGs with Read: assets/panels/04-2.png, nurse.png, main-cast.png, checkin-patients.png and vision-cast.png. For continuity I also looked at 04-1, 05-1, 06-2 and 07-1. The runtime gave me no task ID, so reviewer.task is null.

The nurse matches nurse.png. She has a chin-length wavy black bob with a side part, wide-set bright eyes with slightly lifted outer corners, thick straight brows and a small chin. She wears lavender scrubs with patch pockets, a purple lanyard with a blank white card, white clinic shoes and a watch on her left wrist. Her open-mouthed smile matches the speaking face on her sheet and fits 'Hi, Ravi!'. I cannot confirm the hair is tucked behind her right ear at this angle. That is not a scene requirement.
Ravi matches main-cast.png in face, beard, shirt, trousers and brown shoes. He sits on a teal chair at the lower left, relaxed, smiling and looking at the nurse.

Ravi's hands: his left forearm rests on the side table. A dark blood-pressure cuff is on his left upper arm, the watch is still visible on his left wrist, and a pulse oximeter is clipped on a fingertip of the left hand. His right hand rests on his right knee. This matches production.

The nurse's hands: her right hand, at screen left, holds the black inflation bulb. Her left hand, with the watch, lightly steadies the tube. The tube runs plausibly from the cuff past the monitor to the bulb. This matches production and heldBy nurse.right. The small monitor shows only an abstract wave and a blank pill shape, with no readings.

Shoulder bag: the dark-brown bag stands on the floor beside the chair at the lower left. That matches during 'on the floor beside his chair' and follows from it being on his shoulder in 04-1. I checked the updated 'after' field against the art. In 05-1 and 06-2 the same dark-brown bag stands on the floor beside Ravi's consultation chair, and in 07-1 it is back on his left shoulder at the reception counter. The new wording, 'carried into the consultation and set beside his chair (05-1); back on his shoulder at reception (07-1)', now agrees with the panels. The phone is not visible, which agrees with 'in his trouser pocket'.

Setting: at the right, behind the nurse, there is a white counter with a teal front, a monitor, a plant and part of a teal waiting chair, so the corner reads as beside reception. This matches 07-1's counter. The 04-1 desk front is pale wood, a difference already present between pages, so I do not count it against 04-2. The upper third is plain wall with room for the caption and the nurse's balloon, and the balloon in page-04.svg sits clear of both faces. There is no text in the art.

What I read: I read the request JSON, source/original.txt and page-04.svg (as text). I opened and looked at these PNGs with Read: assets/panels/04-3.png, main-cast.png, nurse.png, checkin-patients.png and vision-cast.png. For the tablet and laptop continuity I also looked at 05-1, 05-2, 05-3, 05-4 and 06-2. The runtime gave me no task ID, so reviewer.task is null.

Dr. Ananya matches main-cast.png. She has a low bun with loose strands and a gold stud earring. Her eyes are calm and almond-shaped, with heavy lids, looking down. Her brows are soft, level and medium-thick. Her face is oval, with a defined chin, a small rounded nose and no bindi. She wears a teal kurta under an open white coat, with the stethoscope around her neck and not in use. Her small closed-mouth smile fits 'ready, attentive'.

Hands: both hands hold the tablet by its left and right edges, with thumbs on the bezel. The finger counts look natural and no fingers are fused. This matches production. heldBy names only ananya.left while the art shows both hands, which is a small record nuance and not an art fault.

Tablet: it is angled toward the reader and slightly from above. It shows a pale card with a teal check badge, small notification strokes and one blank white strip in the middle. There is no text or data, and page-04.svg puts the 'RAVI · READY' label over the screen area. In 05-1 to 05-4 and in 06-2 the tablet does not appear, which agrees with 'put away in the desk drawer'.

Laptop: a closed silver-grey laptop lies at the lower right of the desk, pushed aside. That matches during 'closed and pushed aside'. On page 5 (05-1, 05-2, 05-4) and in 06-2, a silver laptop with a dark bezel stands open with abstract icon cards, so its colour and model match.

Minor spatial note, not blocking: in this nearly frontal shot the window and plant are behind her at screen right, and the closed laptop is on her left. In the similar frontal view of 05-4, and in 05-1, the window is at screen left, and the open laptop is on her right. A strict reader may see the room as mirrored, or the laptop as moved to her other side before she opens it. Page 5 itself shows windows behind both Ananya (05-1, 05-4) and Ravi (05-3), so the room's layout is loose throughout. The difference also does not break the beat. I am noting it here rather than raising it as an issue.

The top third is soft, plain light wall with room for the three-line caption. The art has a thin dark frame line along its top, left and right edges, which 03-1 also has. This will sit under the composited panel border and should be confirmed at lettering. There is no text in the art.
